calibration.L: minimum across eligible per-cell raw p10
calibration.U: maximum across eligible per-cell raw p90
calibration.boundary_statistics_population: finite pixels inside eligible original instances; each unique instance/global pixel counted once; strict clipping <L/>U and boundary <=L/>=U both reported
calibration.bounds_reuse: Existing exact per-cell p10/p90 reused when finite; missing geometry-QC rows re-read from raw pixels independently; normalized 8 features always re-extracted from clipped pixels
calibration.eligible: original instance with at least 5 finite pixels; independent of labels and geometry QC
calibration.pixels: float64 clip((I-L)/(U-L),0,1); invalid support stays invalid
calibration.unit: original WSI / pooled internal WSI with unique cells and nonduplicated pixels / each external core

evaluation: all fixed labelled keys; no NaN/QC filtering; failures retained and full-set metrics marked incomplete rather than subset masquerading as full
scope_update: User requests no rerun of old experiments. Reuse saved old models/predictions; only new E1-E4 fits and required perturbation GMM estimation. Initial read-only baseline checks had already completed before this update.

stability.affine: a*I+b applied to entire calibration unit including local contexts; float64 no bit-depth clipping; full-unit L/U and GMM re-estimated; affine sufficient statistics permitted only after full-pixel representative-unit verification
stability.input_valid: finite required observed intensity with >=5 finite pixels; mask present; required image calibration valid; S-only NaN allowed; paired_valid also requires finite outputs before and after
stability.mask: 1px Euclidean erosion or dilation into ORIGINAL background only; equidistant competitors retain background; all neighbor IDs perturbed; original L/U and original GMM mapping frozen, scores recomputed from changed-mask raw mean
stability.rotation: np.rot90 image, all instance IDs, valid and optional tissue together; preserve IDs; GMM score reusable only after raw mean invariance check

statistics: paired descriptive per image; no cell-level p-values/bootstrap; cores not assumed independent patients

thresholds.old_baselines: Keep original >.5 in both comparison panels; never label baseline threshold as OOF-tuned
thresholds.oof_reporting: Selected-threshold OOF metric is threshold development fitting value, not unbiased performance
thresholds.supplement: E1-E4 only: select grid .01:.01:.99 maximizing mean of 3 WSI F1 from training OOF; ties closest .5 then higher; frozen before new validation evaluation
